title: NTSB bridge and infrastructure investigations as cross-case design/inspection/oversight memory rail
summary: The NTSB bridge/infrastructure safety issue surface is encoded as a cross-case action-memory rail: it links investigations to recurring design-review, inspection, load-rating, oversight, and standards-update questions across bridge and infrastructure failures.

status_history.note: Added as structural failure lane visibility/correction rail.

claims.claim: NTSB’s bridge/infrastructure safety issue page frames bridge and infrastructure safety as a large engineering, construction, inspection, and oversight task and says NTSB investigations highlight key safety issues and needed changes.
what_would_change_status: A second-pass source review materially revises the extraction, narrows its scope, or adds a stronger primary source.

claims.claim: The NTSB page links earlier bridge collapses to standards or guide changes, including Silver Bridge to NBIS, Sunshine Skyway to vessel-collision guidance, Mianus River to fracture-critical-member inspection, and others to underwater/tunnel inspection surfaces.
what_would_change_status: A second-pass source review materially revises the extraction, narrows its scope, or adds a stronger primary source.

claims.claim: The same NTSB page explicitly groups FIU, I-35W, Fern Hollow, and other investigations around structural design, design review, inspection, load-rating, state/federal oversight, and recommendation surfaces.
what_would_change_status: A second-pass source review materially revises the extraction, narrows its scope, or adds a stronger primary source.

limitations: Existence of the rail does not prove signal capture, adoption, enforcement, or correction infusion.

type_payload.infrastructure_class: transportation infrastructure investigation and recommendation memory rail
type_payload.signal_capture_model: post-event investigation, probable-cause statements, recommendations, safety issue pages, and cross-case topic synthesis
limitations: not a primary prevention rail by itself
does not guarantee state/federal implementation or recommendation closure

handling_notes: Represent infrastructure as a visibility/correction rail, not a guarantee of safety.
Avoid implying that absence of records means absence of risk.

unknowns: Utilization, adoption, underreporting, and recommendation-closure histories are not yet extracted.
next_actions: Link infrastructure outputs to specific case recommendation-closure records.

revision_history.note: Promoted as rev0025 structural/civil failure infrastructure record.
